findings.highlight: I know. They're going to catch up.
findings.evidenceJa: 分かってる、すぐに追い付く。
findings.governingReading: Rin urges him to hurry and is running ahead; he answers that he will catch up soon.
findings.explanation: Shirou promising to catch up to Rin becomes unnamed pursuers catching up to them.

findings.highlight: As I run, my blood pumps faster.
findings.evidenceJa: 走れば走るほど血の流れが加速するのか。
findings.governingReading: のか asks whether the more he runs, the faster the blood flow becomes as he struggles with visual disturbance and nausea.
findings.explanation: Questioning an explanation for his symptoms becomes asserting it.

findings.highlight: you doing this is most certainly unfair.
findings.evidenceJa: 私の方こそ、これでは釣り合いが取れなく、なる
findings.governingReading: 私の方こそ reverses Shirou’s give-and-take accounting: his help will make her the one unable to balance the debt, prompting his satisfaction that this hardship will be just once.
findings.explanation: Saber becoming the one who owes too much becomes the carrying itself being unfair.

findings.highlight: This pain won't bring me to my knees.
findings.evidenceJa: こんなもの、死に至る痛みじゃない。
findings.governingReading: He reassures himself that this is not pain leading to death while it still makes him dizzy and nearly collapse.
findings.explanation: Pain that is not fatal becomes pain that will not incapacitate him.

findings.evidenceJa: 安心して休んでいるからじゃない。
findings.governingReading: Closed eyes do not indicate safe repose: worsening heat, sweat and hidden labored breathing explain them instead.
findings.explanation: The denial that Saber is resting comfortably becomes an assertion that she is relaxed.

findings.highlight: I very nearly trip, and skid to a stop, leaning my back against a tree.
findings.evidenceJa: 倒れそうになって、咄嗟に木に背中をぶつけて踏みとどまった。
findings.governingReading: 倒れそう after mounting pain/nausea is an impending collapse; he instinctively strikes his back against a tree to keep upright. Later36 claims merely tripping as his minimization.
findings.explanation: Near-collapse and a desperate impact with a tree become nearly tripping and leaning against it.

findings.highlight: Saber would be pretty upset about the waste of food if I threw up.
findings.evidenceJa: 胃の中のモノを嘔吐した日には、セイバーには別の意味で怒られそうだ。
findings.governingReading: He imagines vomiting stomach contents while carrying her instead of a little blood that did not get on her, and fears her anger for a different reason. The source does not specify wasted food.
findings.explanation: The imagined anger over vomiting gains food waste as its stated reason.

findings.highlight: Saber speaks up from where she lays in my arms.
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーは俺に抱かれたまま、そんな事を口にした。
findings.governingReading: She remains held in his arms and speaks.
findings.explanation: Intransitive reclining is expressed with lays.

findings.highlight: With Rin present, I need not explain myself.
findings.evidenceJa: 凛がいるのなら話が早い
findings.governingReading: 話が早い means they can get to the point or resolve the discussion faster;40 has Rin explicitly ask her to state the point so Shirou understands.
findings.explanation: Having Rin present makes the discussion easier becomes no explanation being necessary.

findings.highlight: says the damnedest things, and always so casually.
findings.evidenceJa: とんでもなく難しいコトを、さりげなく簡単に言う。
findings.governingReading: Shirou is stunned that Rin makes the apparently impossible rescue/escape sound easy. The point is practical difficulty, not simply weird subject matter.
findings.explanation: Casually describing extremely difficult undertakings becomes saying odd things casually.
